theme_strategy.style_archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST + ARCHETYPE 2: THE PERFORMANCE PRO (Dark Minimalist Fintech & Tactical Vehicle/Expense Telemetry)
theme_strategy.mood: Sleek, high-contrast obsidian dark mode, ultra-fast keypad input, crisp monospaced telemetry, zero visual clutter, Swiss clarity in Italian

rules.amounts_and_km: Always render currency figures (€ 1.250,40) and odometer data in font_mono with tabular-nums and tracking-tight
rules.headings: font_heading with font-bold or font-extrabold and tracking-tight

entry_surfaces./: Mobile-first instant keypad expense input with massive € display, quick chips, and live daily balance strip, expandable to full desk dashboard
entry_surfaces./expenses: High-density expense register with category badges, instant search, inline quick-edit category dropdown, and multi-filter header
entry_surfaces./km: Automotive telemetry hub — odometer month start/end/delta, fuel cost per km ratio widget, monthly distance graph, and trip logs
entry_surfaces./fuel: Fuel expense cockpit — total liters, monthly cost, external reimbursement aid calculator, and €/km efficiency metric cards
entry_surfaces./import: Freeform smart text parser studio — paste raw text or 2025/2026 logs, real-time regex preview table with keyword auto-tagging, and 1-click batch ingest
entry_surfaces./analytics: Deep analytics room — interactive category drill-down pie/bar, month-over-month % delta delta, 12-month trendline, weekday spend heatmap, and end-of-month projection

navigation.desktop: Top fixed glass header (h-16, backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0B0F14]/85 border-b border-[#1E293B]) with logo mark 'SPESE 2026', navigation links [Nuova Spesa, Registro Spese, Km & Auto, Carburante, Analisi & Trend, Importa Testo], Quick Total Pill, and Quick Add Action
navigation.mobile: Bottom fixed navigation bar (h-16, bg-[#0E151D]/95 backdrop-blur-lg border-t border-[#1E293B]) with 5 primary icons + floating center '+' action for rapid logging

mobile_quick_add_hero.concept: Tactical POS / Calculator inspired instant entry
components: Massive dynamic input for Amount (€) with fast presets (+5, +10, +20, +50)
Motivo / Descrizione with dynamic auto-category inference tag badge
Date picker defaulting to Oggi (today) with Ieri (yesterday) shortcut
Giant prominent 'Salva Spesa' CTA with tactile press state and instant Sonner confirmation

dashboard_grid.kpi_row: lg:col-span-3 col-span-1 (Total Mese, Spesa Media/Giorno, Km Percorsi, Costo Medio €/Km)

auto_categorization_engine.description: Smart keyword-to-category rulebook (e.g. 'benzina', 'diesel', 'eni', 'q8' -> Carburante; 'conad', 'coop', 'esselunga', 'spesa' -> Alimentari/Spesa; 'tagliando', 'gomme', 'assicurazione', 'bollo', 'autolavaggio' -> Auto & Manutenzione; 'pranzo', 'cena', 'bar', 'caffe', 'ristorante', 'pizzeria' -> Ristoranti & Bar; 'bolletta', 'luce', 'gas', 'affitto', 'condominio' -> Casa & Utenze; 'farmacia', 'medico', 'visita' -> Salute; 'amazon', 'vestiti', 'elettronica' -> Shopping; 'telepass', 'autostrada', 'treno', 'parcheggio' -> Viaggi & Trasporti)
auto_categorization_engine.ui_feedback: Instant animated tag pill showing inferred category while user types motive

km_and_fuel_telemetry.description: Monthly odometer tracker: initial Km, final Km, calculated delta Km, total fuel spent, external fuel aid/reimbursement deducted, true net fuel cost, and exact €/km vehicle running cost
km_and_fuel_telemetry.visuals: Progress gauge, month-over-month Km comparison bar chart, and efficiency benchmark badge

freeform_text_importer.description: TextArea parser that parses raw multi-line notes (e.g. '12/01 35.50 benzina q8' or '05/02 12.00 pizza con marco') with syntax highlighter, preview data grid with editable rows before final database commit, support for importing 2025 and 2026 data files

charts: Recharts ResponsiveContainer PieChart for category breakdown with custom hover tooltip and drilldown modal
Recharts BarChart for Monthly comparisons (2025 vs 2026 when available)
Recharts LineChart/AreaChart for cumulative monthly burn rate vs target projection
Weekday Spending Heatmap (Lun - Dom) matrix showing peak expense days
Top 5 categories table and Top 5 single expense motives leaderboard

motion.transitions: transition-colors duration-150 ease-out, transition-opacity duration-150 ease-out, transition-transform duration-150 ease-out

accessibility.wcag_compliance: WCAG AA / APCA standards with minimum 4.5:1 text contrast on dark obsidian backgrounds
accessibility.screen_readers: All key numbers have aria-label with full descriptive text (e.g. 'Totale speso questo mese: 1.450 euro')
accessibility.data_testids: MANDATORY data-testid on every interactive element (e.g. data-testid='amount-input', data-testid='motive-input', data-testid='save-expense-btn', data-testid='category-select', data-testid='filter-month-select', data-testid='km-initial-input', data-testid='km-final-input', data-testid='import-text-textarea', data-testid='import-parse-btn', data-testid='import-save-btn')

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete Italian personal expense and car telemetry dashboard in FastAPI + React 19 + Tailwind v4 + Recharts.
Implement seed data covering early 2026 entries (January-August 2026) + sample 2025 historic baseline so charts and analytics look immediately rich and functional upon first launch.

Ensure the fast input on Home is lightning fast for mobile: big numeric input with euro sign, smart autocomplete on motive with instant auto-categorization badge, and big primary save button with Sonner toast feedback.

Include the Freeform Text Import feature in a dedicated tab/page (/import) that accurately parses common Italian note formats (e.g., '14/01 45.00 benzina Eni', '15/01 22.50 Spesa Conad') with real-time preview table and editable categories before commit.
Include Km & Fuel telemetry: Monthly Km logs (start km, end km, delta km), fuel expense total, external aid / rimborso input, and calculated €/km ratio with charts.
Include full Analytics page (/analytics): 12-month expense trend line, Category distribution donut chart, Top 5 motives, Weekday spend distribution, and End-of-month forecast projection.
Use dark mode as primary default with obsidian `#0B0F14` page background, `#131B24` card backgrounds, `#223142` borders, and vivid `#0284C7` / `#38BDF8` cyan-sky accents and `#F97316` fuel accents.
Use JetBrains Mono for all numeric values and currency amounts, Manrope for bold headings, and DM Sans for clean UI copy.
Attach data-testid on all interactive elements for robust test automation.
